name: Tessa
source:
[url=/c742]Deuce's[/url] childhood friend. She and Deuce often tease and annoy each other, but both regard each other as family. Along with [url=/c747]Swig[/url], they lived a long time aboard a research station until it exploded, forcing them to relocate to the Oracle's Mothership.
